answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nectar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the canyon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the signal of the next round. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
